content:
将积分写成先对 \(y\) 积分：

\[
\iint_D f(x)f(x^2-y)\,d\sigma
=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x)\left(\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x^2-y)\,dy\right)dx
\]

对固定 \(x\)，令 \(u=x^2-y\)，则 \(dy=-du\)，且 \(y\in\mathbb{R}\) 时 \(u\in\mathbb{R}\)。因此

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x^2-y)\,dy
=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(u)\,du
=\int_{-1}^{2} u\,du
=\left.\frac{u^2}{2}\right|_{-1}^{2}
=\frac{3}{2}
\]

所以原积分为

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x)\cdot \frac{3}{2}\,dx
=\frac{3}{2}\int_{-1}^{2} x\,dx
=\frac{3}{2}\left.\frac{x^2}{2}\right|_{-1}^{2}
=\frac{3}{2}\cdot \frac{3}{2}
=\frac{9}{4}
\]

答案：A
